Name: Handsome Valley Distant Lands - A Small Witch Swamp Expansion - HD Portraits
Author: ElinHime
Description:
[color=#f1c232][size=5][b]Handsome Valley Distant Lands - HD Portraits[/b][/size][/color][size=4]
HD portraits for Aimon111' Distant Lands - A Small Witch Swamp Expansion mod in the Handsome Valley style. Includes all outfit variants.
[/size][size=4]

[/size][color=#f1c232][size=5][b]Installation:[/b][/size][/color][size=4]
This is not a mod that works on its own; it’s just a folder of pictures you need to place inside Portraiture to do anything.

Download the file, unpack it with something like WinZip, and place the Handsome folder inside Portraiture, where you can see the note «Non-Content-Pack-Folders-Go-Here».

Press [b]P[/b] (for Portrait) when you are talking to a character to change portraits.
Press [b]P[/b] again to scroll through your Portraiture Portrait Packs if you have several.
Don’t worry, you only have to do this once.
[i]Portraiture will remember that![/i][/size]


[b][color=#f1c232][size=5]Tech Support:[/size][/color][/b]
[size=4]If you have problems getting it to work, have a friend look through the guide on the Portraiture mod page with you to help you see what might have been done wrong.

If you don’t have a friend, head over to the official Stardew Discord and ask in Mod Support. They are amazing, helpful people, and maybe you will make a friend in there as well.

I know how to make a folder of pictures, don't ask me for tech support. I can't help you.

If you had a unique problem you found the solution to, please be kind and write in Post about it so others can benefit from your newfound knowledge.


[/size][size=4]But if there are other issues like a portrait jumping when it’s not supposed to or a wrongly named portrait, please let me know, and I’ll fix it as fast as I can.
[/size][size=4]

[color=#6aa84f][b]~You enjoying Handsome Valley?[/b][/color] [url=https://ko-fi.com/elinhime]Buy me a coffee![/url] ☕
